The setting is a semi-outdoor dining area with industrial fans and posters on the wall. (2) Close-up insert of a printed board titled '豐仁冰簡介' with dense Traditional Chinese text. The board is mounted on a wall and reflects bright overhead light. (3) Wide shot of a street-side ice stall. A woman in a pink shirt works behind a stainless steel counter with red bins. The man in the black tank top laughs, showing visible facial expressions of joy. The male interviewer reacts with a smile while holding the mic. They are positioned in the center of the frame. Large yellow text overlays appear at the bottom.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to interview the third-generation owner of a legendary ice shop in Taichung, exploring the humorous origins of its name and its long-standing history. It concludes by awarding the owner a sticker from a fictional association to celebrate the shop's cultural impact and playfulness.
